column3: “all the men” renders “every person (adam),” and “their possessions” renders “the property.”
MT 17:2. NASB reorders the clauses; “the blaze” renders “the burning,” and “the burning coals” renders “the fire.”
MT 17:3. “at the cost of their lives” renders “by their souls (nefesh),” and “hammered sheets” renders “beaten plates.”
MT 17:6. “have caused the death of” renders “have killed.”
MT 17:10. “consume them instantly” renders “make an end of them as a moment.”
MT 17:13. “was checked” renders “was restrained” (also in verse 50).
